configs.list.description: List configuration entries page by page: platform principals see platform entries, tenant principals see platform entries plus their own; encrypted values are never returned. Requires settings.configs.read.
configs.get.description: Get a configuration entry (encrypted values are never returned). Requires settings.configs.read.
configs.create.description: Create a configuration entry on the caller’s side: the key is unique per side and the value is checked against the data type; a tenant entry with a platform key overrides it (rejected when the platform entry forbids overrides). Requires settings.configs.create.
configs.update.description: Update a configuration entry on the caller’s side: name, group, value, default, data type, encryption, order, description and status (the key cannot change; an encrypted entry keeps its value when none is given). Requires settings.configs.update.
configs.delete.description: Delete configuration entries on the caller’s side in bulk; built-in entries are rejected one by one. Requires settings.configs.delete.
dicts.list.description: List dictionaries page by page: platform dictionaries plus the caller’s tenant dictionaries. Requires settings.dicts.read.
dicts.create.description: Create a dictionary on the caller’s side; codes are unique across platform and tenants (dictionaries are never overridden). Requires settings.dicts.create.
dicts.update.description: Update a dictionary on the caller’s side: name, category, description, order and status (the code cannot change). Requires settings.dicts.update.
dicts.delete.description: Delete dictionaries on the caller’s side in bulk; built-in dictionaries and those that still have items are rejected one by one. Requires settings.dicts.delete.
dicts.options.description: Get the options of a dictionary by code: tree dictionaries are flattened depth-first, disabled items are flagged, a disabled dictionary has no options. Any signed-in user.
dict_items.list.description: List all items of a dictionary (depth-first, with depth). Requires settings.dict-items.read.
dict_items.get.description: Get a dictionary item. Requires settings.dict-items.read.
dict_items.create.description: Create an item in an enabled dictionary on the caller’s side: the code is unique in the dictionary, the parent must be in the same dictionary, making it the default clears the other default. Requires settings.dict-items.create.
dict_items.update.description: Update a dictionary item: parent, name, value, description, metadata, default, order and status (the code cannot change; an item cannot move under itself or its descendants). Requires settings.dict-items.update.
dict_items.delete.description: Delete dictionary items in bulk; items that still have children are rejected one by one. Requires settings.dict-items.delete.
numbering_rules.list.description: List numbering rules page by page: platform principals see platform rules, tenant principals see their own rules plus platform rules shared with tenants. Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.
numbering_rules.get.description: Get a numbering rule, including its current period and last issued sequence value. Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.
numbering_rules.create.description: Create a numbering rule on the caller’s side: the date format must distinguish the reset cycle and the time zone is an IANA id. Requires settings.numbering-rules.create.
numbering_rules.update.description: Update a numbering rule on the caller’s side; once it has issued numbers the format is frozen and only name, description, order, status and tenant sharing can change. Requires settings.numbering-rules.update.
numbering_rules.delete.description: Delete numbering rules on the caller’s side in bulk; rules that have issued numbers are rejected one by one. Requires settings.numbering-rules.delete.
numbering_rules.reset.description: Safely reset the sequence: the next value must exceed the highest value already issued in the current period (jumping forward is allowed), a reason is required and platform rules need the rule code typed back as confirmation. Requires settings.numbering-rules.reset.
numbering_rules.preview.description: Preview numbers for a given format (pure computation, nothing is issued, up to 50). Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.
numbering_rules.generate.description: Issue numbers from a rule: committed in its own transaction, numbers are consumed permanently; the same idempotency key replays with identical parameters and conflicts otherwise. Requires settings.numbering-rules.generate.
numbering_rules.allocations.description: List a rule’s issue records page by page (a tenant only sees the ones it requested). Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.
